g.text: Chapter 12 on one page: the CIRCLES skeleton
seven steps, one persona, one prioritized need, then the AI checks
say the framework out loud; clarify with the 3W's and H
one persona, kept until the final solution
prioritize one need: A-C matrix or revenue per point of effort
three or more solutions; pros and cons; recommend one
AI: add failure recovery, data needs and cost per task
